$comment: V2 - reference-derived composition (reference/analysis/findings-composition.json, confidence 0.75). SPEC: MASTER_SPEC 2.4-2.5. Positions are % of the 1080x1920 canvas.

referenceShares.$note: Reference frame clusters, not duration-weighted; rightTextLeftObject/split/dualObject/fullFrameSymbolic are allowed by spec but absent or rare in the reference sample

safeArea.$comment: Reference safe margins ~8% x / ~12% y (conf 0.75); bottom kept at 14% to clear platform UI (TikTok/Reels/Shorts chrome) - documented deviation

negativeSpaceRules.$reference: Reference keeps 60-70% of frame empty: one text block + one object (identity finding, conf 0.88); maxElementsPerScene lowered 5 -> 4 to enforce this density

hierarchy.$reference: Hierarchy via type size/weight/accent first, single supporting icon second (reference identity, conf 0.88)

maxElementsPerSceneV2.principle: Dynamic semantic density (Phase 3): budget depends on semantic complexity, relationships, mechanism, narration density and duration. More elements is NOT automatically better - 3 meaningful elements beat 10 decorative ones. Deterministic readability caps still apply (collision detection, safe areas, text limits).
maxElementsPerSceneV2.v1History: Phase 2 enforced a flat max of 4 (reference 60-70% empty); Phase 3 keeps the reference's restraint as a guideline while allowing complex relational beats to reach 10 with documented semantic roles.
